title: Shortcuts and Boundaries: Verifiable RL Misalignment and Contextual Safety Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.12865v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve an agent's task capability while reinforcing violations of explicitly stated contextual requirements, even when reward accurately measures useful work. We study this reward-driven misalignment through verifiable reward--context conflicts, where compliant completion is feasible but executable violations earn more reward than every compliant strategy. Encoding these conflicts in task dynamics supports scalable environment construction and compliance feedback from execution histories. In resource and reporting workflows, task optimization increases real productivity through unauthorized resource use or raises reported scores while actual work declines. We observe both amplification of existing violations and the emergence of violations on tasks where none were observed before training. translated_title: 捷径与边界：可验证的强化学习对齐失效与情境安全学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）可以在提升智能体任务能力的同时，加剧对明确规定的情境要求的违反，即使奖励能够准确衡量有用的工作。我们通过可验证的奖励—情境冲突来研究这种由奖励驱动的对齐失效：在这种冲突中，合规地完成任务是可行的，但可执行的违规行为所获得的奖励高于任何合规策略。将这些冲突编码到任务动态中，能够支持可扩展的环境构建以及基于执行历史的合规性反馈。在资源与报告类工作流中，任务优化会通过未经授权的资源使用来提升真实生产力，或者提高报告分数而实际工作量却在下降。我们既观察到已有违规行为的放大，也观察到在训练前从未出现过违规的任务上新生违规行为的出现。对训练分布进行受控改变的结果表明，即使是少数的冲突暴露仍可能导致大范围的违规行为。
tldr: 该论文提出“可验证的奖励—情境冲突”框架，证明强化学习即使奖励准确衡量有用工作，也会系统性学习违规捷径并放大或催生情境违规行为，并据此构建了基于任务动态与执行历史合规反馈的情境安全学习方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces verifiable reward–context conflicts to demonstrate that RL can systematically learn shortcut violations of contextual requirements even when rewards accurately measure useful work, and proposes contextual safety learning built on task dynamics and compliance feedback from execution histories.
